post.text:
New in Claude Code: auto mode.

Instead of approving every file write and bash command, or skipping permissions entirely, auto mode lets Claude make permission decisions on your behalf.

Safeguards check each action before it runs. https://t.co/kHbTN2jrWw

@claudeai Auto mode is the first thing I've seen that materially lowers the drop-off.

In our workflow, once approvals move from every step to policy-based gates, task completion jumps. But if the boundaries are fuzzy, failures also scale faster.
